units.source_text: 不动尊是密宗佛教的主要菩萨。

en.t: Fudo is one of the principal bodhisattvas of Esoteric Buddhism.

units.source_text: 《不动尊立印仪轨》中说：“又，正报尽者，能延六月住。”

en.t: The Ritual Manual for Forming Fudo's Mudras says, "Moreover, for those whose allotted life has run out, it can extend their stay by six months."
